description:
Motivation is cheap. Money on the line isn't.

GymTaxx turns your gym goal into a deposit contract with yourself. Lock a refundable deposit, commit to a weekly workout target, and earn back your own money one verified gym visit at a time. Skip a session, and that £5 stays locked. No hype, no gimmicks — just a system that makes showing up the easier option.

Choose your commitment level. Pick 3, 4 or 5 workouts a week and lock a matching deposit of £60, £80 or £100. Higher goal, higher stakes — you decide what pressure gets you moving.

Earn back what's yours. Every verified gym check-in unlocks £5 of your own deposit. There's no pot, no prize, no money from other users — you're only ever earning back what you put in.

A new challenge starts every Monday. Your four weeks begin on the next Monday, so the longest you'll ever wait to start is six days. Join on a Monday and you're in that same day. Weeks run Monday to Sunday, and your Sunday deadline ends at midnight where you live.

Real humans check your check-ins. A live camera photo at the gym gets reviewed by an actual person, not an algorithm you can fool with an old screenshot. Each check-in also records where you were, so a gym visit can be confirmed. If a check-in isn't approved, you'll get clear feedback and a direct line to support before your week closes.

See your progress at a glance. A simple ring shows money earned back, your current streak and workouts completed this week. Watching your own deposit unlock is a different kind of motivation.

Your data, your control. Delete your account and every check-in photo from inside the app whenever you want. No hoops, no waiting.

GymTaxx isn't about luck, chance or outcomes you can't control. It's about whether you show up. Lock your deposit, commit to four weeks, and make skipping the gym cost you something.

Download GymTaxx and put your own money where your motivation is.

promotionalText: Lock a refundable deposit. Earn back £5 per verified gym visit. A fresh four-week challenge starts every Monday, so you'll never wait more than six days.
whatsNew:
A new four-week challenge now starts every Monday. Whenever you join, you begin on the next Monday, so the longest you'll ever wait is six days instead of weeks.

Your week now follows your own clock. Your Sunday deadline ends at midnight where you live, fixed when you sign up so a trip abroad can't move it mid-challenge.

Gym location is captured far more reliably at check-in, and we now ask for it during sign-up instead of interrupting you at the gym. A weak signal indoors can no longer cost you a workout — the check-in still counts and gets flagged for review.

Deposits are shown and charged in pounds in the UK and in dollars elsewhere, locked to the currency you joined in so a refund always comes back in the same money.
